title: Manager/Senior Manager, Global Quality Systems
text:
***Who We Are:***

Xenon Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:XENE) is a neuroscience-focused biopharmaceutical company dedicated to drug discovery, clinical development, and commercialization of life-changing therapeutics for patients in need. We are looking for great people who thrive in a respectful, collaborative, inclusive, and productive culture to join the Xenon team.

***What We Do:***

We are advancing an exciting product pipeline to address indications with high unmet medical need, including epilepsy, depression and pain. Our late-stage azetukalner program represents the most advanced, clinically validated potassium channel modulator in late-stage clinical development for multiple indications. In March 2026, we announced positive topline data from our Phase 3 X-TOLE2 study of azetukalner in focal seizures (FS), and we submitted a New Drug Application to the Food and Drug Administration in the third quarter of 2026. Our Phase 3 epilepsy program also includes a second FS study, X-TOLE3, which would support regulatory submissions outside the U.S., and the X-ACKT study in primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures, which would support regulatory submissions for an additional epilepsy indication. We also are investigating azetukalner in major depressive disorder (MDD) and bipolar depression (BPD), based on topline data from our Phase 2 X-NOVA clinical trial. In addition, we continue to advance an early-stage pipeline of novel ion channel candidates, including studies of XEN1701 and XEN1720 (targeting Nav1.7) and XEN1120 (targeting Kv7), which are being developed for pain. Backed by a strong balance sheet to support our growth plans, we continue to build a fully integrated, premier neuroscience company with strong discovery, clinical development, corporate, and commercial operations.

***About the Role:***

We are seeking a **Manager/Senior Manager, Global Quality Systems,** who will provide leadership and oversight across key Quality Management System (QMS) processes, including quality events, investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control. This role will serve as a key quality partner across GxP functions, helping to identify systemic issues, strengthen investigation practices, and drive sustainable, risk-based improvements that support compliance, inspection readiness, and operational excellence. The role will work closely with internal teams and external service providers across Xenon’s outsourced operating model to ensure the QMS remains effective, compliant, and inspection ready.

The ideal candidate will bring strong Quality Systems experience, broad GxP knowledge, and sound business judgment, with the ability to effectively challenge investigations, facilitate meaningful root cause analysis, and influence stakeholders across functions. The role will also support quality governance, QMS metrics and trending, change control review, and the continued optimization of electronic quality systems.

This position reports to the Associate Director, Quality Assurance, Systems and will be based out of Boston, MA, USA in our Needham office. This role is a hybrid position, requiring a minimum of two onsite days per week. The level of the position will be commensurate with the candidate’s education and industry experience.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Quality Systems & Governance**

 + Manage the oversight, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of GxP Quality Systems, including quality events, investigations, CAPA, change control, and associated governance processes.
 + Ensure consistent, risk-based practices for investigation, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change management, including review and approval of records and escalation of significant quality or compliance risks.
 + Monitor QMS performance through metrics, trending, CAPA effectiveness, and Quality Management Review reporting to identify systemic risks and drive continuous improvement.
* **Compliance, Inspection Readiness & eQMS**

 + Assess QMS processes and proposed changes for GxP, regulatory, validation, training, documentation, and data integrity considerations, maintaining alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and industry expectations.
 + Support the administration, optimization, validation, upgrades, and continuous improvement of the eQMS and associated procedures, guidance, and training.
 + Support regulatory inspections and internal and external audits, including inspection readiness and responses to observations and findings.
* **Quality Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**

 + Provide Quality Systems expertise, guidance, coaching, and training to promote consistent, inspection-ready, and risk-based quality practices across the organization.
 + Partner with GxP functions and external service providers to establish quality expectations, resolve quality issues, implement compliant changes and CAPAs, and drive cross-functional quality improvement initiatives.
 + Promote a strong quality culture through effective stakeholder engagement, sound judgment, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* **General Responsibilities**

 + Act in accordance with Company policies, including the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and ensure applicable policies are understood and followed by direct reports, if any.
 + Other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 5–8+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other regulated industry, with demonstrated experience in Quality Systems, Quality Assurance, or compliance.
* Demonstrated experience with quality event management, including complex investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control.
* Strong working knowledge of QMS requirements, quality risk management principles, and applicable GxP regulations, including GMP and familiarity with GCP, GVP, and GLP.
* Experience with electronic Quality Management Systems such as Veeva Quality, MasterControl, or equivalent, including supporting system implementation, optimization, or maintenance.
* Experience developing, reviewing, and maintaining quality procedures, SOPs, metrics, and trending to support risk-based decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Experience supporting quality governance activities, regulatory inspections, internal or external audits, and inspection readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders while effectively navigating ambiguity and driving quality initiatives to completion.
* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance strategic judgment with a hands-on approach to execution.
* Excellent organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

Our Total Rewards program includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options, as well as a full range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, short-& long-term disability, accidental death & dismemberment, and life insurance programs, Employee Assistance Program, travel insurance, and retirement savings programs with company matching contributions.

Xenon encourages time to rest and re-charge through vacation, personal days, sick days, and an end-of-year company shutdown. Xenon highly values employee development and has an expanding Training, Learning & Development program, including a Tuition Assistance program for advanced degrees.

Compensation Range: $131.3K - $173.3K
